Guide

RPG: committed design and staged production

An original online high-fantasy 2.5D action RPG set in the Talarin Reach.

On this page
Player experienceFirst playable versus full designWorld and scope constraintsOwnership commitment

Player experience

Create a common-body Vanguard, Ranger, Arcanist or Warden. Travel between authored valley, woodland, marsh, highland, mountain and coastal zones. Fight server-owned enemies with spatial attacks and soft targeting, complete quests, gather ore/wood/fish, craft equipment, trade with merchants, specialize skills and join cooperative parties.

The fixed elevated camera follows without free rotation and provides clamped zoom. Characters and animated creatures are 2D sprites; floor geometry, collision, slopes, stairs, bridges, interiors and water are 3D. Movement is 360 degrees across X/Y with Z elevation: jump, dodge, sprint and swim, no climbing.

First playable versus full design

CaseContract
Slice A / through08Two clients, dedicated server, authenticated fixtures, durable state, individual two-zone transfer, enemy combat and XP. Minimal item/reward schemas precede rewards.
Slice B / through15Creation, village quest, fight/loot, mining/woodcutting/fishing, craft, buy/sell, equipment, XP, death/recovery, reconnect and transfer.
Later committed /16–23Four-class talents, six-zone content pipeline, dungeons, social/chat/friends/trade, factions/fast travel, guilds, operations, packaged and measured tests.
Conditional committedMounts require art/movement proof. NPC schedules require safe services/navigation. Optional herbalism shares infrastructure only after verification.
Deferred optionalPvP, raids, housing, auction house and monetization are separate disabled expansion gates.

World and scope constraints

The common body is not a verified range of race silhouettes. Four-facing archive descriptions are prompt-supplied, not an eight-direction asset audit. Additional art is needed for magical casting/healing, swims/dodges where missing, diagonals, mounts and many clothing combinations. No finished 3D environment assets are supplied.

Level50, item rarity, XP curves, costs and travel times are tunable proposals, not tested balance. Start with Vanguard/Ranger to de-risk available weapon pages while documenting all four classes. Do not require the entire six-biome world before basic movement.

Ownership commitment

Clients request and render. Zone servers validate movement/combat/world actions under current session authority. A small authenticated backend and PostgreSQL persist character/economy/quest/profession/social facts. UI, animation, local GameInstance and SaveGame never become online truth.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
